title: Parking, Transport and Emergency Services
text: Vehicle parking near the central Peth areas (Kasba, Budhwar, Raviwar Peth) is restricted during the festival; PMC designates temporary parking zones at Swargate, Shaniwarwada grounds and PMC head office parking, from where shuttle rickshaws run to the main darshan routes. Two-wheeler parking is generally easier to find near Nana Peth and Ganesh Peth. PMPML runs special extended-hours bus services connecting Swargate, Pune Station and Shivajinagar to the central mandal areas until 1 AM during the 10-day festival. Emergency medical booths are stationed near Kasba Ganpati, Tulshibaug and Dagdusheth Halwai, staffed by PMC health department volunteers and St. John Ambulance teams. For emergencies, dial 108 for ambulance or contact the nearest police chowky; Vishrambaug police chowky covers the central Peth darshan route.
